messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you sell your acoustic guitar quickly and safely: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning (strings, fretboard, body). Tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑presented instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Capture the whole body, headstock, strings, fretboard, and any imperfections. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of disputes over condition. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music stores. Note price ranges for similar models, ages, and conditions. | Helps you set a realistic price and avoid underselling. | | **4. Write a Detailed Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, condition notes, any upgrades, and why you’re selling. Mention if it’s still under warranty or has a recent appraisal. | Transparency builds trust and reduces back‑and‑forth questions. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments, global reach.
• **eBay** – auction or fixed price, large audience.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local music shops** – consignment or direct sale. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; use a mix for maximum exposure. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target to allow room for negotiation. Consider adding a “price‑match” clause if you’re willing to meet a higher offer. | Gives you flexibility while still aiming for a good return. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • **Local pickup**: safer, no shipping cost.
• **Shipping**: use a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS) with insurance and tracking. Pack the guitar in a hard case or padded box. | Shipping expands your buyer pool but adds cost and risk. | | **8. Handle Payment Safely** | • **Cash**: safest for local sales.
• **PayPal / Venmo**: secure, but beware of scams.
• **Bank transfer**: verify before shipping. | Protect yourself from fraud and ensure you receive full payment. | | **9. Meet Safely (if local)** | • Choose a public place (coffee shop, police station, or a friend’s house).
• Bring a friend if possible.
• Verify the buyer’s ID and confirm payment before handing over the guitar. | Reduces risk of theft or non‑payment. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | • Sign a simple bill of sale (include serial number, price, date, and both parties’ signatures).
• Keep a copy for your records. | Provides legal proof of transfer and protects both parties. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing**: Spring and summer are peak times for instrument sales (students, touring musicians). - **Negotiation**: Be prepared to negotiate but know your lowest acceptable price. - **Safety**: Never accept a check or wire transfer until you’ve verified the buyer’s identity and the funds are cleared. - **Legal**: If you’re selling a high‑value instrument, consider a formal contract or a professional appraisal. ### Example Listing (Reverb) > **Title**: 2015 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition > **Description**: > • Brand: Yamaha > • Model: FG800 > • Year: 2015 > • Condition: Light wear on the fretboard, no cracks. > • Extras: Original case, extra strings, and a small repair kit. > • Reason for sale: Upgrading to a 12‑string. > • Price: $350 (negotiable). > • Shipping: Free within the U.S. (insured). > • Local pickup available in Austin, TX. > **Photos**: [Attach 5–7 images] > **Contact**: Email or phone. Follow this framework, adjust details to fit your specific guitar, and you’ll be on your way to a smooth sale. Good luck!
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We can provide steps: research market value, clean instrument, take photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb, local classifieds), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention potential appraisal, trade-in, or consignment. Provide tips for negotiation, safe meeting, payment methods. Also mention legal aspects. Provide a concise guide. No function call needed.
